headline: Surya Roshni Posts Record Q2 FY2027 Revenue Amid Margin Pressures
summary: Indian manufacturer Surya Roshni reported record revenue for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, though slides indicated lingering margin pressures.
why: Surya Roshni Limited is a prominent Indian manufacturer of steel pipes, lighting products, and home appliances, serving both domestic and international markets.
